name: zigshape-vscode
description: Generate idiomatic Zig structs from JSON, YAML, TOML, and XML — with first-class serde.zig support.

commands.title: ZigShape: Paste Clipboard as Zig Struct
ZigShape: Generate Zig Struct from Current File
ZigShape: Generate Zig Struct from Multiple Files

explorer/context.when: resourceLangId == json || resourceLangId == jsonc || resourceLangId == yaml || resourceLangId == toml || resourceLangId == xml

editor/context.when: resourceLangId == json || resourceLangId == jsonc || resourceLangId == yaml || resourceLangId == toml || resourceLangId == xml

zigshape.target.description: Codegen target. plain emits std.json-compatible structs; serde-zig adds rename/alias/xml decoration.

zigshape.preset.description: Inference preset. api → smallest int widths + auto enums; strict → conservative u64 + observed defaults; loose → wide u64.

zigshape.rootName.description: Struct name for the root type.

zigshape.intStrategy.description: Override the preset's integer width strategy.

zigshape.denyUnknownFields.description: Emit serde.zig .deny_unknown_fields = true on every struct (serde-zig target only).
